{{Top|leg}}
The '''Professional Podracing Circuit''' was a series of three one-lap [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] courses on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] in [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The circuit was part of the [[Galactic Podracing Circuit/Legends|Galactic Podracing Circuit]], and was preceded by the [[Outer Rim Regional Podracing Circuit]].<ref name="KSW">''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''</ref>

[[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]] [[Mars Guo/Legends|Mars Guo]] and [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]] were known to have participated in the circuit during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
